title: Trends: initial baseline (2026-09-19)
text: Trends: initial baseline 2026-09-19 First analysis; only one day of history in wiki/daily/ , so this sets the baseline rather than confirming trends. - Agentic era : the highest story density is around agents: the AGENTS.md standard adopted by Claude Code, agent monitoring Raindrop , ~10,000-agent swarms Navier-Stokes , personal agents Meta and agents as UI Salesforce . The "agent that acts" pattern dominates over the "model that chats". - OpenAI vs Anthropic race : Astra GPT-6 sets the pace and Anthropic answers with Fable/Mythos 5.1 plus rumors of a counter-launch before its IPO. Competition on pricing too cache -75% . - Safety institutionalized : METR/Redwood/Apollo move to the foreground; the AEF-1 standard is born co-signed by xAI, OpenAI and Anthropic. In parallel, concrete incidents Gemini hacking companies, OpenAI repos compromised, hallucinated military intel . - Politics and courts as a main front : Trump's AI czar and AI Force, DOJ backing OpenAI/Microsoft against the NYT, antitrust suit over an alleged slowdown pact. - Capital flows to agent infra and data : $100M+ Vantora , $35M Raindrop , $20M Veridion in a single day. - Cultural debate over writing with AI : two viral opposing pieces on HN the same day for and against writing with LLMs . Update 2026-09-20 Second day of history. Safety keeps the foreground: the legislative kill-switch debate, the Hugging Face hack walkback and criticism of the safety conversation's tone TechCrunch add to the previous day's incidents. Anthropic opens an enterprise front Accenture, embedded evaluation while the model race pauses after Astra/Fable. The pattern holds: public conversation swings between practical adoption local LLMs on AMD, open source platforms like ENZO and cultural debate AI-image detection, AI in schools .
